description: Leo zodiac sign: personality traits, strengths and challenges, love, career, decans and dates (July 23 to August 22).
answer: In Western astrology, Leo is the fifth sign of the zodiac, a fixed fire sign ruled by the Sun. It is traditionally associated with warmth, generosity, creative confidence and a big, loyal heart. The Sun is in Leo from about July 23 to August 22.

sections.heading: Leo personality traits
paragraphs: Leo is the zodiac's performer and host, the sign most associated with radiance. The Lion has long stood for royalty and courage, and Leo tends to carry a dignity and presence that people register the moment it walks in. Yet the deeper story is about the heart. This sign wants to create, to love generously and to be seen for who it truly is. Many Leos keep a childlike delight in play, celebrations and grand gestures; they are frequently the ones organising the party, planning the surprise or championing a friend who has gone unnoticed. Recognition matters to them, but so does handing it out.

Leo is a fixed fire sign ruled by the Sun. Fire brings enthusiasm, warmth and creative energy; fixed signs sustain, so this flame is a steady blaze rather than a flicker. The Sun, the centre of our solar system, represents identity, vitality and self-expression, and as the Lion's ruler it highlights a need to shine and to live authentically. Together these suggest a personality that is loyal, proud, expressive and consistent in its affections. Leo's natural place is at the centre, but at its best it uses that spot to warm everyone nearby, the way sunlight falls on a whole garden without asking for anything back.

sections.heading: Leo strengths and challenges
paragraphs: Generosity is Leo's signature. It gives time, praise, gifts and encouragement freely, and its loyalty to friends can be unshakeable. Confidence comes fairly naturally, which makes the Lion a ready leader and a strong advocate for anyone it believes in. Its creativity surfaces in performance, design and storytelling, or simply in making an ordinary Tuesday feel festive. Leo is often brave about self-expression, willing to stand out and take creative risks that others shy away from. Warm, playful and dignified, it has a knack for making people feel special, and many Leos lift those around them through sheer enthusiasm and open pride in their achievements.

The appetite for recognition can become a soft spot. When it feels overlooked, Leo may chase attention in less constructive ways, turn theatrical or feel wounded out of proportion to the slight. Pride can make admitting mistakes or apologising unusually hard, so the Lion sometimes defends a position out of bruised dignity rather than conviction. A fixed sign's stubbornness can show up as resistance to feedback. Some Leos slip into arrogance or a habit of dominating conversations. Underneath there is often real sensitivity to criticism and a fear of not being enough, rarely visible because the confident front is so convincing.

sections.heading: Leo in love and relationships
paragraphs: Leo loves with its whole heart and likes the world to know it. Romance, for this sign, often means grand gestures, generous gifts, affection in public and genuine pride in a partner's company. The Lion is usually loyal and protective, treating a beloved like royalty and hoping for similar devotion in return. It offers warmth, fun and the glow of being chosen. Admiration and appreciation are what keep it happy, along with a partner who celebrates its wins instead of competing with them. A Leo who feels taken for granted can turn hurt or distant, so regular acknowledgement goes a remarkably long way.

Pride is the usual stumbling block. In a disagreement, Leo may find it hard to back down or say sorry, and a partner can end up feeling their own needs are eclipsed. Jealousy flickers if the Lion senses rivals for attention. Honest, kind feedback delivered in private helps, as does generous recognition of the effort Leo puts in. For its part, this sign matures in love when it learns to share the spotlight and listen as attentively as it performs. Aries and Sagittarius tend to match its fire, while Gemini and Libra bring the playful conversation and admiration it so enjoys.

sections.heading: Leo at work
paragraphs: Leo tends to thrive where it can lead, create or perform. Entertainment, the arts, management, entrepreneurship, teaching, politics, events, fashion and any client-facing role with a sense of occasion suit it. The Lion often lifts morale and energy in a team and is good at motivating people who have lost their spark. As a boss, it is typically generous with praise, protective of its staff and confident about setting a vision. Leo wants its work to reflect who it is, so creative ownership and visible credit matter a lot. Given the right stage, it can produce work of real distinction and inspire everyone around it to raise their game.

The pitfalls involve ego and delegation. Leo may bristle at criticism, claim credit a little too readily or resist handing over authority. A workplace that offers no recognition can drain its motivation fast. With money, the Lion is generous and fond of quality, sometimes spending lavishly to impress or to treat others. That open hand is admirable but can strain resources. Linking spending to genuine values rather than appearances keeps things in proportion. Celebrating colleagues' achievements openly can make Leo an even stronger leader, and accepting feedback gracefully often unlocks the next stage of a career it clearly cares about.

sections.heading: Growth and the three Leo decans
paragraphs: Leo's growth edge is building a sense of worth that does not depend on applause. Creative work done purely for joy, with no audience at all, can be a powerful practice. So can catching the moments when it fishes for reassurance and asking what it actually needs underneath. Learning to apologise quickly and sincerely, without feeling diminished, strengthens every relationship it has. The Lion also grows by deliberately lifting others into the spotlight, mentoring, crediting and cheering them on, which often proves more satisfying than holding the stage alone. Generosity is already a strength; turning some of it inward as self-compassion when things go wrong helps Leo recover from setbacks with grace instead of wounded pride.

Leo divides into three decans of ten degrees each. The first, roughly July 23 to August 1, belongs to the Sun; the second, about August 2 to August 12, to Jupiter; and the third, around August 13 to August 22, to Mars. Each has its own page, and every Leo birthday links to its decan.

faq.question: Why do Leos need attention?
faq.answer: Leo is ruled by the Sun and tied to self-expression, so being seen and appreciated matters deeply. The need usually reflects a wish for genuine recognition rather than vanity. Leos tend to give attention generously in return, especially to the people they love.

faq.question: What is Leo's biggest strength?
faq.answer: Generosity of spirit is usually named first. Leos tend to be warm, loyal and encouraging, handing out praise, time and support freely. Their confidence also helps them lead and inspire, which makes them natural champions for friends and colleagues alike.

faq.question: What are the dates for Leo?
faq.answer: About July 23 to August 22. The Sun's entry into each sign moves by a day or so between years, so birthdays at either end are cusp dates; the zodiac sign calculator settles them for a specific year.

faq.question: What are the three Leo decans?
faq.answer: The first decan (0° to 9°) is linked with the Sun, the second (10° to 19°) with Jupiter and the third (20° to 29°) with Mars, following the rulers of the fire signs in zodiac order.
